versions.content: If SoAd_IsConnectionReady () is called and the referred socket connection has a socket assigned, SoAd shall call TcpIp_IsConnection- Ready () to pass RemoteAddrPtr for the corresponding socket. The return value of TcpIp_IsConnectionReady () shall be forwarded to the caller.
